passage.text: Some people say your favorite color can tell us about your personality.
passage.reading: sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ jʊr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌlər kən ˈtɛl ʌs əˈbaʊt jʊr ˌpɜːrsəˈnæləti.

passage.text: People who love red are energetic and confident.
passage.reading: ˈpiːpəl huː ˈlʌv ˈrɛd ər ˌɛnərˈdʒɛtɪk ənd ˈkɑːnfɪdənt.

passage.text: People who love blue are calm and patient, and they're very good friends.
passage.reading: ˈpiːpəl huː ˈlʌv ˈbluː ər ˈkɑːm ənd ˈpeɪʃənt, ənd ðɛr ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd ˈfrɛndz.

passage.text: If your favorite color is yellow, you're probably cheerful and creative.
passage.reading: ɪf jʊr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌlər ɪz ˈjɛloʊ, jʊr ˈprɑːbəbli ˈtʃɪrfəl ənd kriˈeɪtɪv.

passage.text: People who love green are adventurous: they enjoy nature and new places.
passage.reading: ˈpiːpəl huː ˈlʌv ˈɡriːn ər ədˈvɛntʃərəs: ðeɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈneɪtʃər ənd ˈnuː ˈpleɪsɪz.

passage.text: And people who love purple are often emotional and kind.
passage.reading: ənd ˈpiːpəl huː ˈlʌv ˈpɜːrpəl ər ˈɔːfən ɪˈmoʊʃənəl ənd ˈkaɪnd.

passage.text: Of course, this is only for fun.
passage.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs, ðɪs ɪz ˈoʊnli fər ˈfʌn.

passage.text: Nam's favorite color is green, but she isn't very adventurous!
passage.reading: ˈnɑːmz ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌlər ɪz ˈɡriːn, bʌt ʃiː ˈɪzənt ˈvɛri ədˈvɛntʃərəs!
